name: Bafs Inc.
old_description: With over twenty years of experience in the airline catering industry, we offer a versatile range of products for airlines, inflight kitchens, cruise lines, and rail car dining. We manufacture products for all levels of service and will custom design a product to meet your needs. BAFS has many years of success with medical, therapeutic, and special dietary meals. We offer individual portions or bulk packaging for galley plating. Our Registered Dietitian ensures each of our products exceeds the standard. We offer products in all SPML categories:
about:
BAFS Inc. operates from Bangor, Maine, where it has spent over two decades serving the airline catering industry and related food-service sectors. The company does not disclose a founding year or founder names, and its ownership structure is not publicly stated.

The facility produces frozen entrée components, center-of-plate items, bulk sauces, starches, and medical or therapeutic meals for special dietary needs. Services include frozen food manufacturing, co-packaging, custom formulation, and private-label production, with product development offered from concept through production. The company emphasizes lower production minimums but does not publish facility size, headcount, or annual volume figures.

Customers span commercial airlines and inflight kitchens, cruise lines, rail-car dining operators, senior-nutrition programs such as Meals on Wheels, healthcare meal providers, and the U.S. Department of Defense. The company also supplies medical and therapeutic entrees for specialized diets.

BAFS highlights its registered dietitian who reviews every product to exceed nutritional standards, and it promotes a full product-development cycle from initial concept to finished goods as a key differentiator.
built_on: Registered dietitian oversight on all products
Full product development from concept to production
Multiple federal and third-party inspections (HACCP, FDA/USDA, DoD)
